board: Rhode Island Board of Accountancy (Department of Business Regulation)

cycle.label: Reporting period
cycle.note: Rhode Island licenses run three years ending June 30: 120 hours, at least 6 of them ethics. No yearly minimum.

requirements.label: Self-study
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 80 self-study hours count per period (§1.8.1(D)).

requirements.label: Personal development and marketing
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 24 hours of personal development or marketing per period (§1.8.2(C)).

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: At least 6 hours (4 in your first cycle) covering regulatory and behavioral ethics (§1.8.2(E)). No Rhode Island-specific course is required.

byIssueYearInPeriod.note: First renewal cycle: 80 hours, including 4 of ethics (§1.8.1(A)(3)).

licenseDateHint: Rhode Island licenses expire June 30 every three years; your license shows which year.
issueDateHint: New licensees: 80 hours, including 4 of ethics, for the first renewal cycle.
limitsNotTracked: Teaching: max 60 hours; authorship: max 60 hours.
If your main office is in another state, meeting that state's rules satisfies Rhode Island's.
recordRetention: Keep CPE documentation for the current and the previous renewal period (§1.8.1(E)).
toVerify: New licensees: 80 hours with 4 ethics for the first cycle; licensed in the period's last year assumed to owe none (no CPE in the year issued).
